module: Crash replay camera (hidden). Depending on camMode: 1 = close camera above the impact point (hitPoint + camOffset, fov 50); 2 = fixed camera on the ground about 10-20 m from the impact point (random fov 20-25). If veh2Id is provided and the second vehicle's driver is looking at the first, starts in cockpit view (fov 40) until the bounding boxes touch. Returns a constructor.

C.desc: Crash camera. Fields: camMode, veh1Id, veh2Id, hitPoint, camOffset, camPos, fov, cockpitView.

setCustomData.desc: Configures the shot (called when the global camera is chosen).

data.desc: veh1Id (vehicle hit), veh2Id (optional), camMode (1|2), hitPoint (vec3), camOffset (vec3, mode 1)

update.desc: Writes data.res.pos / rot / fov depending on the mode.

notes: update does not check that veh1Id exists (Lua error if the vehicle disappears).
